## Behavior spec for `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable`

### 1. Argument parsing (`std::stof` semantics) — all argv parsing happens BEFORE any output

| Command | Exit | stdout | stderr |
|---|---|---|---|
| `abc 0 0` | 134 (SIGABRT) | **empty — zero lines, not even the 5 defaults** | `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::invalid_argument'` + `  what():  stof` |
| `0.5 0.2 0.3 abc 0 0` (bad in 2nd triple) | 134 | empty | same as above |
| `0.5abc 0.2 0.3` | 0 | normal; parsed as `0.5 0.2 0.3` (trailing garbage silently ignored) | — |
| `0x1p-1 0 0` | 0 | parsed as `0.5 0 0` (hex floats accepted) | — |
| `inf 0 0` | 0 | `Color 5: inf 0 0 0 -nan inf 0 -nan inf -nan -nan -nan -inf inf -inf inf 1 0 0 1 0 0 -nan -nan -nan inf inf inf -inf 1 1 inf ` | — |
| `-inf 0.5 0.5` | 0 | `Color 5: -inf 0.5 0.5 -nan -nan -inf -nan inf 0.5 inf 0 0 0.5 -inf inf -inf 0 0.6 0.6 0 0.4 0.4 -nan -nan -nan -inf -inf -inf inf 0.5 0.5 inf ` | — |
| `nan 0 0` | 0 | all-nan line: `Color 5: nan 0 0 nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan nan 0 0 nan 0 0 nan nan nan nan nan nan nan 1 1 nan ` (note invert of nan prints `1 1 nan`) | — |
| `1e2 0 0` | 0 | `Color 5: 100 0 0 0 -1.02041 50 0 1 100 0 1 1 -99 29.9 -14.7 61.5 1 0 0 1 0 0 50 50 50 21.26 21.26 21.26 -99 1 1 99.9007 ` | — |
| `1e40 0 0` | 134 | empty | `std::out_of_range` / `what():  stof` |
| `1e-50 0 0`, `1e-40`, `1.4e-45` | 134 | empty | `std::out_of_range` — glibc `strtof` raises ERANGE for **subnormal** results too |
| `"  0.5" 0.2 0.3`, `+0.7`, `"  .3"`, `1e-1` | 0 | leading whitespace, `+`, bare `.3`, exponents all parse fine | — |

Key point confirmed: a bad argv string aborts before ANY stdout (parsing loop runs before the print loop).

### 2. Incomplete trailing args — ignored
`0.5` and `0.5 0.5` (1 or 2 extra args) produce exactly the 5 default colors, exit 0. Distance `0.948683` appears on the last (Color 4) line. Same for 1 triple + 1 stray (`0.2 0.4 0.6 99` → 6 colors).

### 3. Multiple triples
